text: Areeba Javed’s account (PK**BAHL****9447) has shown an unusually high volume of cash deposits during August 2026, with 27 deposits ranging from PKR 308,000 to PKR 3,280,000, totaling approximately PKR 45,000,000 in a single month. The pattern of daily cash inflows, many exceeding PKR 2,000,000, is inconsistent with the customer’s declared monthly turnover of PKR 76,000,000 and typical grocery wholesaler cash flow. Additionally, the customer has repeatedly transferred PKR 7,801,000 to Metro FMCG Distributors (Synthetic Bank C) on 5th, 12th, 19th, 26th, and 27th August, each transaction labeled “STOCK INVOICE.” The timing of these outflows coincides with the cash deposits, suggesting a possible layering or placement scheme to disguise the origin of the funds. The synthetic nature of the account and the absence of any known sanctions or PEP matches do not mitigate the red flags. The combination of high-frequency, high-value cash deposits, repeated identical outflows to the same counterparty, and the customer’s medium risk rating warrants filing a Suspicious Transaction Report.
